description: This file defines the ReportData interface in the OrangeHRM system, specifying methods for normalization and retrieving metadata related to report data.
external_methods: /* Assuming typical methods of ParameterBag for illustration */

classes.name: ReportData
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for normalizing report data and retrieving associated metadata.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Produces an associative array representation of the report data.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with the report data, returning a ParameterBag or null.
